searchText: Hi all, is there a working set of clients for devnet 5? I haven't managed to get a working CL / EL pair yet. I've been using client commit versions pinned in <#892088344438255616> and config from https://github.com/ethpandaops/mekong-devnets/tree/master/network-configs/devnet-0/metadata The network itself is having issues right now and is likely cause of some chaos when you're trying to sync. What are your logs indicating? Well I just realised I'm trying to use the mekong network configs with the devnet versions of the code base <:facepalm:405166949065293825> . I'll get the devnet configs in and take another run at it. Thanks for replying <@199561711278227457> <@199561711278227457> FYI I've been trying these versions of geth/lighthouse: * geth version: `1.14.13-unstable-f24d6f6a` (from `prague-devnet-5` in `github.com/s1na/go-ethereum`) * lighthouse version: `v6.0.1-b6d80eb` (from `b6d80eb` in `github.com/eserilev/lighthouse`) And it seems to get stuck with this from `geth`: ```json {"msg":"Error whilst processing payload status","level":"WARN","ts":"2025-01-21T14:04:19.809918079Z","service":"exec","error":"Api { error: ServerMessage { code: -38005, message: \"Unsupported fork\" } }"} {"msg":"Execution engine call failed","level":"WARN","ts":"2025-01-21T14:04:20.725811707Z","service":"exec","error":"ServerMessage { code: -38005, message: \"Unsupported fork\" }"} ``` which branch of lighthouse is this? from `b6d80eb` in `github.com/eserilev/lighthouse` - i went for the specific commit that was pinned in <#892088344438255616> And this isn't the official repo, it's the https://github.com/eserilev/lighthouse fork If there is a branch I should be using instead please let me know and ill whack that out and see can you build the latest of this branch and try? https://github.com/eserilev/lighthouse/tree/single_attestation cc <@491624610215886849> if there's a better branch Yeah happy to, give me a few mins <@199561711278227457> same issue with `single_attestation` - version built `Lighthouse v6.0.1-42c01c6` ah im sorry i didnt realize you posted a link of the genesis files. mekon is pinned for devnet-4 images, the spec changed. So either you use the images you have and these config files: https://github.com/ethpandaops/pectra-devnets/tree/master/network-configs/devnet-5/metadata or you use mekong genesis files and these images: https://github.com/ethpandaops/mekong-devnets/blob/master/ansible/inventories/devnet-0/group_vars/all/images.yaml <@199561711278227457> I am using devnet-5 configs. **Previously** I was using mekong.

ah im sorry i didnt realize you posted a link of the genesis files. mekon is pinned for devnet-4 images, the spec changed. So either you use the images you have and these config files: https://github.com/ethpandaops/pectra-devnets/tree/master/network-configs/devnet-5/metadata

or you use mekong genesis files and these images: https://github.com/ethpandaops/mekong-devnets/blob/master/ansible/inventories/devnet-0/group_vars/all/images.yaml
